title: The same block in a small box and a large one
process: how the answer at a block depends on where the model box is cut: upslope of it, and downslope of it through a hollow
executor: node (CPU surface solver) and browser (GPU); raw measurements in street/raw/, scored by run.mjs
equations: upslope cut: the depth at the block is the kinematic depth for the length of slope above it that is inside the box, h = (i x / alpha)^(3/5); a box cut x_box below the divide reads (x_box / x_true)^(3/5) of the true depth
downslope cut: a hollow holds water to its rim only if the rim is inside the box (PV-SS2)
boundaryConditions: the app's edge on all four sides of every box: free outfall
geometry: up: a plane 200 x 6 m at 2 %, n 0.016; the block at 150 m from the divide; boxes [0, 200) m and [120, 180) m. down: the PV-SS2 street; the block is the hollow's floor at 30-36 m; boxes [0, 60) m (whole), [0, 48) m (cut below the rim) and [20, 36) m (cut through the hollow and across its catchment)

cases.unit: rain mm/h and min; times s; x in the scene's own metres

solver: FloodSim surface solver with the app's settings (hdry 1e-5 m, hfront 1e-3 m, dtDry 2 s; MUSCL minmod, HLLC, SSP-RK2, CFL 0.48). cpu rows: src/solver-cpu.js (fp64). gpu rows: src/solver-gpu.js in Chrome WebGPU (fp32).

reference.independence: the true answer is the hand answer for the whole terrain

outputs: up: steady depth at the block in each box against the true depth, and in the small box against the depth its own slope length gives
down: end and peak depth at the block in each box against the true depths
reported: the share of the rain that leaves across the edge in each box
criteriaNotes: The large boxes are held to the PV-SS1 and PV-SS2 limits. A small box passes if the block reads within 10 % (or 5 mm) of the true depth. Predicted before running: SS5-up-small fails (the hand answer is 38 % of the true depth) and SS5-down-small fails (its edge drains the hollow); SS5-down-ok passes.
assumptions: the free-outfall edge lets nothing in
limitations: two idealised cuts; a real box is cut on all sides at once
validRange: rain-fed flooding (no river); boxes cut across a slope or through a hollow
scoring: automated: street/score.mjs builds rows with lib/score.mjs row(); one row set per executor (cpu, gpu), never merged; a case with no raw file is listed as not run and has no rows

criteriaRevisions.why: first registration, before any sandbox case was run
